[Story]
Colleague Xiao Liu always complains about not having a high salary. Director Zhang knows there are promotion opportunities within the company and wants to persuade Xiao Liu to change his perception: job prospects are more important than salary.

[Question]
How does Director Zhang convince Xiao Liu?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Director Zhang can suggest regular assessments and feedback on personal development to ensure Xiao Liu sees his progress.
B. Director Zhang can encourage Xiao Liu to set career goals and provide support to achieve these goals.
C. Director Zhang can discuss long-term career planning with Xiao Liu, so he sees the opportunities the company can provide for his future.
D. Director Zhang can give Xiao Liu more responsibilities and challenges to show trust and the possibility of promotion.
